system.description:
ENCHANTMENT GRIMWARD MENTAL SAVE
Grimward Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (verbal)
Range 60 feet
Targets Your Judged Subject
Saving Throw Will
Duration 1 minute

You pronounce a binding sanction based upon everything you have learned about the Subject's behaviour.
Critical: The target is unaffected.
Success: The target cannot use Reactions until the end of its next turn.
Failure: The target becomes Slowed 1 and cannot use Reactions for the duration.
Fumble: The target becomes Slowed 2 until the end of its next turn, then Slowed 1 for the remainder of the duration, and cannot use Reactions.
At the end of each of its turns, a target suffering the Failure or Fumble result may attempt a new Will saving throw. On a Success or better, the spell ends.
